hero.title: Language Courses in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: **Language courses in Mauritius** are a good option for students, working professionals and international learners, who want to improve their communication skills for education, employment, travel or everyday life. Universities, cultural institutions and training providers are providing learners with the chance to learn English, French, Chinese and other languages. **Language courses in Mauritius** provide opportunities to learners with varying levels of proficiency and learning goals. These options also make **language learning in Mauritius** accessible to people with different academic and professional interests.

overview: French language training and certification opportunities have been established by Mauritius through the Institut français de Maurice. The Open University of Mauritius provides foundation courses in English and French. The Mahatma Gandhi Institute also teaches languages, including an introduction to Modern Chinese. Students exploring **language courses in Mauritius for international students** can compare these options according to their learning requirements.

faq.question: What languages can I learn in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Dependent options for provider and intake. Confirmed examples include foundation courses in English and French at the Open University of Mauritius, French at the Institut français de Maurice and introductory Modern Chinese at the Mahatma Gandhi Institute. Here are a few options available to students exploring Language Courses in Mauritius.

faq.question: What is the average price of language courses in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Fees vary depending on the institution and course. For example, the Open University of Mauritius has listed a total of US\$176 for its foundation English and French courses for international non-SADC learners, while the Mahatma Gandhi Institute has listed MUR 4,000 for Modern Chinese – Level I, plus a registration fee.

faq.question: Are there any courses in Mauritius for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. Some courses are for beginners. The Modern Chinese – Level I course at the Mahatma Gandhi Institute, for example, is an introductory course for people who have never learned the language before.

faq.question: Is it possible to prepare for an official French language exam in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Yes. The Institut français of Mauritius offers training courses for the TCF and DELF/DALF exams. Please check with the institute for the examination dates, level and fees.

faq.question: How much time does a language course in Mauritius take?
faq.answer: Duration varies according to course and level. The Open University of Mauritius offers its English and French foundation courses with a minimum period of one year and maximum of two years. Some of the other providers may run language courses of shorter duration. Learners in Mauritius can opt for Language Courses in Mauritius to enhance their communication skills for academic, professional and personal development. Before you sign up, it’s wise to compare institutions, course length, eligibility, fees and certification options to find a language learning in Mauritius program that’s right for you. Whether you are exploring English and French language courses in Mauritius or other language options, check the course details and admission requirements before enrolling.
